fields.statement: Verified at aae248c36 (diff 9ea73a5ea..HEAD read). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/workflow-env$' passes: a workflow with [env] FOO={run_tmp}, PLAIN=x runs a command step that sees FOO as an existing folder and PLAIN=x, with no GOTMPDIR, and the FOO folder is gone after the run; a workflow without [env] sees neither GOTMPDIR nor FOO. engine.stepEnv and session_run no longer add GOTMPDIR (EnvGoTmp removed); they set the [env] pairs and create the run tmp folder only when {run_tmp} is used. go test ./internal/workflow/... ./internal/run/... pass (TestEnvTable, TestStepsGetEnvRunTmp, TestRunTmpGoneAfterFailedRun, TestNoEnvNoRunTmp); TestSessionRun in internal/api passes (the package-level FAIL is the root guard seeing the live daemon rewrite ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which is unrelated). Attempt 1's finding is fixed: with this commit's build, rhiza workflow check passes on all five .rhiza/workflows/*.toml, and [env] sits below autonomous in bugfix and plan-bug.
